summary: Creating a Slack OAuth app is straightforward and can be done in minutes via the Slack API dashboard. No approval is required to install the app to your own workspace, but publishing to the App Directory requires a separate review process.

steps.text: Go to https://api.slack.com/apps and sign in with your Slack account
Click 'Create New App' and choose 'From scratch'
Enter app name and select the workspace to develop in
Under 'OAuth & Permissions', add redirect URI(s) and select required scopes
Save the Client ID and Client Secret shown under 'Basic Information'
Install the app to your workspace using the 'Install App' button

blockers: Redirect URIs must use HTTPS (except localhost for development)
Scope changes after installation require re-authorization by users
App Directory submission has separate guidelines and review timeline
Rate limits apply to API calls (varies by method and tier)
